notes.title: Robo Puzzle Smash on Nintendo Switch
notes.content:
Hi Robo Puzzle Smash fans!

We have some HUGE news!  We're hard at work on a big update to Robo Puzzle Smash, and as part of that we're looking to bring it to Nintendo Switch!

If you want to help out and see Robo Puzzle Smash on Switch we have a Kickstarter at: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/bcole/robo-puzzle-smash-for-nintendo-switch]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/bcole/robo-puzzle-smash-for-nintendo-switch[/url]

We're super excited to bring more fans to the game!

notes.title: Welcome new players!
notes.content:
A big thank you to everyone who came out to play at Too Many Games! And welcome to all the new players who picked up a copy!  Say hi in the community and reviews are always welcome!

We have more updates, news, and bug fixes coming soon!  Thanks so much for being a fan!

- Ben

notes.title: Robo Puzzle Smash at Too Many Games: June 21-23, 2019
notes.content: We're bringing Robo Puzzle Smash back to Too Many Games June 21-23.  Stop by and say hi!  We'll be running tournaments throughout the show, and will be bringing the arcade cabinet version!  See you there!

notes.title: Robo Puzzle Smash Soundtrack Available
notes.content:
Robo Puzzle Smash's Original Soundtrack is now available: 
[url=https://pxlplz.bandcamp.com/album/robo-puzzle-smash-original-soundtrack]https://pxlplz.bandcamp.com/album/robo-puzzle-smash-original-soundtrack[/url]

Groove out the the smooth sounds of Robo Puzzle Smash any time.

You can also pick up the soundtrack on a limited edition LP in random colored vinyl!  Makes a great gift for all the puzzle fans in your life!

notes.title: Robo Puzzle Smash launches November 15th
notes.content:
[b]Robo Puzzle Smash launches November 15th[/b]
Finally, after what seems like forever, we've set a launch date for Robo Puzzle Smash!  

Get ready to smash your way through your opponents in arcade story mode or take your game online and brawl across the world.

Three difficulty options and a local tournament mode round out the features! Make sure you wishlist now if you haven't!  See everyone on the 15th!

notes.title: We're going to Game-A-Con in Atlantic City
notes.content:
If you're in or near Atlantic City stop by and see us!  We'll be bringing Robo Puzzle Smash to Game-A-Con October 19 - 21, 2018.  The game is putting on the final touches now and we can't wait to show it!

Of course, we'll be running a tournament too!  Hope to see you there!

notes.title: Robo Puzzle Smash at Too Many Games 6/22 - 6/24
notes.content: We'll be showing off (a nearly complete) Robo Puzzle Smash at Too Many Games in Oaks, PA.  If you're in the neighborhood come by and play a round!  We'll be hosting a tournament with prizes too.  You can get tickets here: [url=http://www.toomanygames.com]http://www.toomanygames.com[/url]
